test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Queer somebody's pitch
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Upset someone's plans.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Queer somebody's pitch**" means to spoil or ruin someone's plans
